meta.title: Recaf MCP
meta.description: Gives the agent the recaf-mcp tool set (classes, methods, search, cross-references, renames, export, bytecode editing) over stdio. DSH starts the MCP server, and the server starts a headless Recaf only when a tool needs it, then stops it again after three idle minutes, so only the Python process stays resident. Tools appear as mcp__recaf__<tool>; the first call takes a few seconds while Recaf boots. One Recaf at a time on this host, stopped again after three idle minutes.
